crime_highlights: Kyle then attacked Mr. Burrows with an extended baton
Mr. Burrows was struck on the head and fell to the ground
Mr. Campbell, after a time, joined the assault to assist Kyle when Mr. Burrows fought back
Mr. Campbell produced what the parties agreed was an imitation firearm
Mr. Burrows believed it to be a real firearm and was scared
Mr. Burrows suffered bruises to his body, significant blood loss, a broken finger
rationale_highlights: the Gladue factors in Mr. Campbell's life are an important factor, particularly considering his background
Mitigating factors specific to this case include Mr. Campbell's experience with parental neglect and violence, familial and cultural dislocation
a sad pipelining effect that occurs for many Indigenous children who are taken into care, and then graduate into the criminal justice system
Mr. Campbell's life trajectory represents examples of the severe impacts of our shared colonial history on Indigenous peoples and families
note: Conclusion is only implicit: factors called important and mitigating; no explicit culpability statement.
